name: RollerCoaster Tycoon 9 Mega Pack
summary:
This compilation collects RollerCoaster Tycoon, RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, RollerCoaster Tycoon 3, and their major expansion packs. In these games, players design and manage amusement parks, build rides and attractions, monitor finances and guest behavior, and complete scenarios with different objectives and settings.

RollerCoaster Tycoon starts with undeveloped land and limited funds, and players build attractions while managing park finances and guest reactions. Ride statistics include excitement and nausea ratings, while simulated ride physics affect coaster performance. The Added Attractions Pack adds more roller coasters, shops, ride enhancements, miniature golf, a ghost train with underground sections, and a suspended monorail. Loopy Landscapes adds further rides and shops, six park themes, 30 scenarios, and several real amusement parks from England.

RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 expands the park-building systems with larger parks, additional attractions, themed environments, and new coaster types. It includes 25 Six Flags roller coasters and five parks based on real Six Flags locations. The Time Twister expansion adds further rides, scenery, and gameplay options, while Wacky Worlds introduces scenarios, attractions, and scenery based on locations and landmarks from every continent.

RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 moves the series to fully 3D environments, with freely controllable cameras and the Coaster Cam, which allows rides to be viewed from a passenger perspective. It also expands guest simulation with group behavior and additional guest characteristics. The Soaked! expansion adds water parks, swimming pools, water slides, and aquatic attractions, while Wild! adds animal enclosures, safari attractions, animal shows, new coaster types, and more rides and scenery. adds animal enclosures, safari attractions, animal shows, new coaster types, and additional rides and scenery.
